ex.en: Her paper was published in a medical journal.
ex.zh: 她的論文刊登在一份醫學期刊上。

ex.en: Scientists read journals to keep up with new research.
ex.zh: 科學家閱讀期刊以掌握最新研究。

ex.en: My dad keeps a journal every day.
I want to be a journalist.
Mr Tani is not so much a scholar as a journalist.
ex.zh: 谷先生與其說是學者，不如說是新聞工作者。

ex.en: There's a job opening in our marketing department.
ex.zh: 我們行銷部有一個職缺。

ex.en: I saw the job opening on the company's website.
ex.zh: 我在公司網站上看到這個職缺。
